Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (August 23, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: RFQ 2104-18-0128 Description: For the non-exclusive supply, delivery, installation, programming, testing, maintenance, repairs, diagnostics and warranty of HID multi class SE card readers and related parts and accessories, as, and when required, for the City of Toronto Facilities Management-Corporate Security Division, from the date of award, for a period of two (2) years, with the option to renew the Contract for two (2) additional, separate one (1) year periods. Should the option(s) be exercised, then the Manager of Materials Management and Stores will request the Chief Purchasing Officer to process the renewals under the same terms and conditions.
